run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum shortest distance for pairs summing to k in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of shortest distance pairs
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes minimum max-distance for element pairs that sum to target k
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that maps array values to their shortest distance from array edges
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use direct dict access instead of b.keys() for better performance
